# F3Nyx — Fulgor ⚡

Ember lit the way; **Fulgor** brings the flash. Release IX makes QR sharing work the same in both directions, fixes the smart-panel layout on 1080p boards and makes the landing animation easy to see.

## ✨ What's New

- 📲 **Show QR on Transmit** — Transmit now has the same round **Show QR** and **Scan QR** buttons as Retrieve. Tap **Show QR** and F3Nyx starts sending and shows the QR full screen; the moment the receiver scans it, the progress ring takes over.
- 🔁 **Either phone can show the QR** — Whichever phone shows the QR, the other taps **Scan QR**. The steps are the same on both screens.
- ℹ️ **Button help** — A small round **i** next to Code explains what Show QR and Scan QR do. Tap it again to hide.
- 🎯 **One-time phone codes** — A code scanned from a phone is used for one transfer only, so your next send never waits for a phone that has moved on. Panel codes still last 10 minutes.
- 🫧 **Water-drop taps everywhere** — The soft ripple now plays on the phone / panel switch and on Transmit / Retrieve, not just on Files, Folder and Text.
- 🌓 **Lighter Direct / Store switch** — The unselected half is now see-through, so only the chosen mode stands out.

## 🛠️ Fixes

- 🏫 **Panel layout on 1080p boards** — The **Received today** list no longer disappears behind an empty progress card, and the **Big QR**, **New code** and **Animation** buttons are no longer cut off.
- 🦸 **Landing animation** — The landing pose now shows on the receiving phone. A hidden tab was cutting it short, and the crouch now holds long enough to see.
- ♿ **Screen readers** — The round Show QR and Scan QR buttons now read out their names.

## 📥 Two Versions

1. **Standard** (about 16 MB) — works with both old and new croc. Pick this if unsure; recommended for smart panels.
2. **Lite** (about 12 MB) — newest croc only, smaller download.

Both look and work the same, and either installs over the other.

## ⚠️ Important — Before You Install

1. **Coming from Ember:** install over it. History and settings stay.
2. **Smart panel:** the landing animation is still off by default there; tap the round **Animation** button beside the QR to turn it on.

Received files are saved in `Downloads/F3Nyx`. Needs Android 8 or newer on a 64-bit phone.

## 📦 Based On

F3Nyx (formerly Crovan and Kroc-Sauria) is a fork of [Croc](https://github.com/schollz/croc) by schollz.
The underlying Croc project and its original authors remain credited.
